confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on secondhand travel-blog, Expatica and Numbeo-derived figures dated 2023 to 2026. Most of that data is Zurich-skewed and adjusted down for Interlaken. Restaurant meal anchors were cross-checked against a 2026 French-language Interlaken cost guide (restaurant lunch about EUR 28 and three-course dinner about EUR 44 per person). Cocktail was anchored to Zurich bar pricing and wine to a restaurant-glass range, and both were kept in a bounded relationship to the beer anchor because direct Interlaken data was thin. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak-July resort demand; no booking pages or current listings were checked. CHF figures were converted to USD at an assumed 1 CHF = about 1.25 USD, which was not searched. The FX observation (RBA 4pm reading for 18 November 2026) came from a search-result excerpt of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, not a full page read, and the 19 November reading was not checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a Swiss alpine lake-and-mountain resort town. Food and drink follow Swiss national and Zurich/Geneva ranges, adjusted down for a smaller resort. Accommodation is set against peak-July demand in comparable Swiss resort towns.
